top_signals.title: Warsh's Pushback On Guidance Adds Volatility: Lyngen
top_signals.summary: Ian Lyngen, Head of US Rates Strategy at BMO Capital Markets, and Stephanie Roth, Chief Economist at Wolfe Research, join Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." US Treasuries fell a day after the Trump administration’s surprise decision to increase buybacks of longer-dated bonds, showing the move did little to counter angst about the surging government debt that pushed some yields to a 19-year high. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
